chunks: The Commander of the Faithful, عليه السلام, said:
"Washing the head with al-khaṭmī removes dirt and cleans away impurities."

key_terms.بِالْخِطْمِيِّ: with al-khaṭmī, a cleansing herb used for washing

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام say about washing the head with al-khaṭmī?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a practice of cleanliness and personal care attributed to Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. It highlights that washing the head with al-khaṭmī helps remove filth and purify unclean matter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.293 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Washing the head with Al-khatmi (a type of herbal shampoo or marshmallow root) removes dirt and purifies impurities”.
